text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan didn't come, even though it 
was time for training. Getting worried, I 
started searching around—

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, that character collab lip balm is 
so cute! —Yeah, I've been seeing that 
mascot everywhere lately. —Right?! I even 
memorized its name!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Collabs truly are a treasure trove of 
possibilities. To win over new fans, maybe 
the Chan-mê doll should collab with 
something too—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Agent Trainer. Machan is currently 
on a spy mission.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What kind of characters are people 
naturally drawn to...? I am currently 
searching for that information.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In order to become an Ultra Super Mascot, 
it is vital to understand demand... In 
other words, market research is essential.
choice_data_list:
Training is important too, don't you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Of course. Because winning the race is—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
............Oh dear, oh my. Was today 
supposed to be a training day?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Auugh... Pure, proper, and adorable. Those 
are so important for a mascot, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. For Chan-me to make 
such a blunder... I am in deep 
reflection...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since they apologized repeatedly 
afterward, I let it slide with just a 
light warning this time.
